Hi All,
As a follow-up to our report last year entitled Bankrolling Bigotry, we ve recently released (in collaboration once again with
ISD) a follow-up report following a similar rubric but focused on payment facilitators that route funds to extremist groups in
Germany. See attached - we are always keen to hear questions, comments, reactions, etc., from this esteemed group.
Thanks!
Danny
